title: The Twinkling Woven Christmas Front Porch
description: A light-up woven Christmas front porch, all from Sam's Club: a Member's Mark pre-lit woven snowman, pre-lit woven tree, pre-lit woven bells set of 3, gold hanging bell decor on evergreen ribbon and a Home for the Holidays coir doormat.
intro: The front porch is the first thing anyone sees, and most of the year mine is a pile of boots and a package. So for Christmas it gets the glow-up: a woven snowman that twinkles, a woven tree on the other side of the door, three light-up woven bells on the steps, gold bells hanging on the door and a Home for the Holidays mat. Pull into the driveway after dark and it looks like a holiday card. That's the whole point.

sections.heading: The light-up trio
paragraphs: The Member's Mark Pre-Lit Woven Snowman (48 inches tall, 80 warm white twinkle LEDs), the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Woven Tree (60 inches tall, 135 twinkle LEDs) and the Member's Mark Pre-Lit Woven Bells, Set of 3 (28, 24 and 18 inches, 130 twinkle LEDs). All rated for indoor and covered outdoor use.

sections.heading: The finishing touches
paragraphs: The Member's Mark Hanging Bell Décor in Evergreen: three gold bells on a long green ribbon for the door. And the Member's Mark Holiday Coir Doormat in Home for the Holidays, with a red bow and holly border.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The house, the door color, the garland, the bench, the dog and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, color and size before you buy.
